plan.purpose: Explain remaining desert wet bias and seasonal monsoon errors without changing model coefficients, inputs or physics. Development data only; no adoption or tuning in this diagnostic.
checks: Exact benchmark input identity and scoring footprint
Ordinary T and P benchmark losses reproduce to 1e-10
Recorded source terms reconstruct the recorded steady equation within float32 storage roundoff
All output packets, including adverse findings, are retained
plan.limitations: The column transport is the existing parameterized concentration form; these diagnostics are not source-water tracers, observed evaporation or proof of a closed global budget. Trace ascent terms are nonlinear closure inputs, not additive rain fractions.

plan.declared: 2026-11-02, after the declared four-region r42 moisture diagnostics, before any prototype result
plan.purpose: Test whether net branch descent should subtract column-wind convergence rather than independently drying an ascending monsoon column.
plan.formula: extra = max(requested_extra - max(-Gaussian_300km(div(column_wind)), 0), 0), rates in s^-1; existing latitude and prior-rain gates retained, no enhanced drying under divergence.
plan.controls: Fresh ordinary r42, copied prototype disabled (all eight full-domain climate arrays must match exactly), then prototype enabled; each with identical declared Earth inputs and unchanged strict numerical checks.
plan.selection: Diagnostic hypothesis screen only. Report every region, including regressions. No candidate adoption from these four regions. Any promising mechanism requires the full 49-region policy-v3 search, paired fine grid and a prospectively frozen finalist before unseen set e.
plan.limitations: Kinematic net-rate closure, not a solved 3-D momentum or energy budget. Column convergence does not uniquely determine vertical motion at every height; the 300 km averaging scale is declared, not fitted here. No claim of global optimum or independent climate validation. Production physics and running search/release remain unchanged.
